review_evidence: The source defines interval and scale structures and transformations rather than only an executable audio/UI wrapper.
LeanMusic/Intervals.lean proves positivity, bounds and delta/sum identities for interval operations; LeanMusic/Utils.lean adds supporting integer theorems.
Complete scan of five Lean files finds eight theorem declarations across two files, establishing an independent proposition/proof surface.
summary: Reviewed LeanMusic; retain its formalized interval/scale structures and proved algebraic facts.
